To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
travelers’ adoption of ORs is influenced by product ranking, information value-added (usefulness), information relevance, information timeliness, information accuracy, and information quality.
the quality of information and its relevance to the decision-making task are important predictors of the adoption of information from online reviews in accommodation decisions.

travelers’ adoption of online information about accommodation is affected by the perceived usefulness of information (i.e., information accuracy, information timeliness), information quality (i.e., product ranking, information value-added), and relevance (i.e., accommodation relevance).
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding how information quality affects travelers’ adoption of ORs and how product ranking influences the adoption of ORs.
the factors that influence travelers to use online reviews as an information source.
how the information in ORs affects the decision-making process of high-involvement consumers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the information quality of online reviews has a strong influence on the adoption of information from online reviews.

the more the traveler is willing to invest in the purchase decision process and the higher the involvement in the decision, the more likely the traveler is to be influenced by the quality of the information and the ranking of the accommodation in the ORs.
travelers’ adoption of e-word-ofmouth is driven by both the quality and the ranking of the information.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
travelers’ adoption of ORs is influenced by both central and peripheral routes of persuasion.
travelers’ adoption of online information is influenced by the quality of information, the ranking of products, and the credibility of reviewers.
travelers’ adoption of e-word-of mouth information is a multi-dimensional construct that is influenced by the central and peripheral route of persuasion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
information quality, as well as product ranking, is important for the adoption of information from e-WOM.
marketers of accommodation should focus on improving the quality of their online reviews to increase the adoption of information from online reviews by their customers.
marketers should consider both information quality and product ranking when they develop their OR strategies.
